scope: Native MuJoCo CPU feasibility diagnostic; privileged goal-joint controller, not learned-policy evaluation or Warp validation
target_method: Forward kinematics at sampled goal joints; goals clipped to actuator limits
controller: Each control step adds clip(goal_qpos-current_ctrl,-0.05,0.05) to six arm controls; controller receives privileged goal joint coordinates
limitations: These 64 samples establish feasibility for the sampled cases, not all possible goals or control paths.
No policy learning or policy inference was involved.
Native CPU simulation does not independently validate GPU Warp behavior.
